newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish ruling party MPs more opposed to EMU - poll.
newsitem.headline: Swedish ruling party MPs more opposed to EMU - poll.

text.p: More parliamentarians in Sweden's ruling Social Democrat party have turned against Swedish membership in Europe's monetary union (EMU), a poll by a Swedish radio station showed on Wednesday.

Radio news programme Ekot asked 159 of 161 Social Democrat parliamentarians about their views on Swedish EMU membership at this time. Of those surveyed, 63 said they were against it, 32 for and 64 were undecided.
Six months ago, at the time of a previous survey, the difference between those for and those against was only four members of parliament.
Ekot also asked about whether there should be a referendum about EMU. Of those surveyed, 143 answered no, nine yes, and seven had not decided.
